chapter_meta_description: A trap set for Ji Ning’s Xingtian God finally springs. Chibing True Immortal’s black chains and a red vase threaten to end the battle—just as Yu Wei’s soul brand silently tears her apart.
og_title: Desolate Era 533: Black Chains Bind the Xingtian God
og_description: Chibing True Immortal’s hidden technique locks Ji Ning down with nine spatial chains and a red jade vase.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 533: The Trap Closes
twitter_description: Nine black chains bind Ji Ning’s Xingtian God as a red jade vase pulls him in. The Seamless Gate has sprung its trap.

lore_anchors.definition: A second body cultivated by a Primal Daoist that shares the same soul; gives the cultivator a second life.
A mass war formation requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals and 1,000 Celestial Immortals, manifesting a towering headless Fiendgod spirit.
A powerful True Immortal dispatched by Immortal Wuxiao with a special technique designed to neutralize Ji Ning's Xingtian God.
A permanent mark on a cultivator's soul that can override free will, used by the Seamless Gate to control their spies.
A compilation of Heartforce application techniques from Old Man Yuan, whose soul-coordination method can multiply the number of controllable magic treasures.
The extremely dense, high-grade ki contained within a Pure Yang True Immortal's Golden Core; a precious resource for powerful spells.
The Seamless Gate agent who communicates with Yu Wei via dreams; his single question at the war's start is the only contact she has had from the Gate.
